purpose: Machine-readable recovery map for the accepted Fleeced runtime architecture. Documentation only; never import as valuation logic.

accepted_contracts.trade_consolidation: Value Adjustment only; Package Quality Penalty is not active in current V256 runtime
accepted_contracts.inquirer_rotation: 8 teams per reporter per week; every reporter covers every team once across four consecutive weeks
accepted_contracts.inquirer_article_archives: immutable standalone per-reporter article JSON + reporter archive index
inquirer_live_context: winning/losing streaks from completed Sleeper matchups
playoff-line/push context when season timing makes it meaningful
player fantasy points plus real-life Sleeper stat line
multi-game player hot/cold form when enough weekly history exists
accepted_contracts.inquirer_house_style: Hometown beat reporter + fan; frequent sarcasm and embedded humor; first-person rooting interest; rival needling and self-deprecating team frustration allowed; all football facts remain Sleeper-grounded.
accepted_contracts.inquirer_article_standard: Full long-form beat column: ~9–10 substantive paragraphs when data exists; minimum regression target 400 words; narrative analysis of season meaning, recent history, score construction, players, lineup/transactions, opponent quality, playoff/next-week stakes, and a closing kicker.

inquirer_team_value_watch.fallback: earliest valid observation when fewer than 7 days exist; label as AVAILABLE history

inquirer_availability_sources.byes: verified NFL schedule source already used by scoring/import pipeline
inquirer_availability_sources.rule: withhold unsupported claims when source data is unavailable

accepted_contracts.inquirer_league_overview_archive: inquirer/league-overview/<season>/week-<NN>.json and indexed into all four reporter archives
